test_notification_panel_closes_on_reclic.title: Verify clicking the bell icon again closes the notification panel.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Trigger an LPR event or ensure an LPR notification exists
steps.expected: An LPR notification appears in the notification area

steps.action: Click the notification bell icon to open the notification panel
steps.expected: Notification panel opens showing recent notifications

steps.action: Locate and click the LPR notification entry
steps.expected: The LPR notification is selected

steps.action: Verify a video preview loads within the notification panel
steps.expected: Video preview displays the LPR event footage inline

steps.action: Verify the video preview shows the correct LPR event details
steps.expected: License plate data and timestamp match the notification

steps.action: Close the notification panel
steps.expected: Panel closes cleanly, returning to the previous view

test_notification_panel_reopen_after_clo.title: Verify notification panel can be reopened after closing

steps.action: Open the notification panel, close it with the bell, then open it again.
steps.expected: The panel's mute control leaves on close and is back on reopen, its icon file naming the mute state, under the Notifications heading.
